I'd reply with no actions this turn.

---

Here's how I understand it. When a member books a lane and doesn't turn up, the lane sits empty while people on the waiting list miss out. To cut those no-shows, every member with a booking gets a text at 18:00 the evening before. Members who ticked "no texts, please" never get texts from the club, and that includes these reminders.

What I found in the booking app:
- Nothing sends reminders yet. The club already texts its newsletter through an SMS provider, so the reminders can go out the same way.
- 23% of members have ticked "no texts." As the spec stands, they get no reminder at all. That's nearly a quarter of members, and their missed sessions would continue as they do now.
- Email isn't a full fallback either: 61% of members have no email address on file. I haven't yet checked how many of the "no texts" members have one, and I can.

Tell me if I've got any of that wrong.

The question that would change the build most is what the "no texts" members should get. My pick would be to email the reminder to those who have an email address and send nothing to the rest. That respects what they asked for, but some of them will still get no reminder. The other option is to add a separate tick box on the form for "booking reminders only." That reaches more people, but it changes the membership form and asks them to opt back in. Which way would you go?

Or if you'd rather I just dive in, say so.
